summary: Iteration 124 validation of 5 CI enhancements + regression. Backend pytest: 13/13 passed — owner mute GET default/PUT true/PUT false persist, owner-nudges preview reflects muted (per-group muted flag, personalized excludes muted admin), auditor-link GET/POST generate/reissue (new token, old 404)/revoke, signed PDF endpoint returns application/pdf attachment (>5KB, starts with %PDF), invalid/revoked token → 404, /brief/recipients shape + updates after settings PUT adds an auditor. critical_code_review_comments: control_intelligence.py exposes a clean surface for the new endpoints; owner_nudges_preview only computes muted set when at_risk exists, which is correct.

Signed PDF stamp wrapped in try/except silently swallows watermarking failures — logged as warning but PDF still returned unstamped in edge cases. Consider surfacing to caller with a header flag for auditability.
auditor-link/revoke uses update_many which is idempotent and correct. Good.
